optimized_sql:
SELECT dt.d_year AS d_year, fi.i_brand_id AS brand_id, fi.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
) dt
INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON dt.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
) fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
GROUP BY dt.d_year, fi.i_brand, fi.i_brand_id
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
